subject: general
question:
1. There are four friends Punit, Kaushal, Rakhi and Jagjeet.

2. Punit and Kaushal play rugby and cricket.

3. Kaushal and Rakhi play rugby and badminton.

4. Punit and Jagjeet play cricket and basketball.

5. Rakhi and Jagjeet play badminton and basketball.

Who among the following plays cricket, basketball, and badminton?
solution:
**Explanation: **

 
• Punit and Kaushal play rugby and cricket.
 
• Punit and Jagjeet play cricket and basketball.
 
• Kaushal and Rakhi play rugby and badminton.
 
• Rakhi and Jagjeet play badminton and basketball.

 

Punit will play rugby,cricket and basketball. kaushal will play rugby, cricket and badminton. Rakhi will play rugby, badminton and basketball. **Jagjeet will play cricket, basketball and badminton.**
